text:
sara_csm: Heads-up — HalcyonHealth tokens/day plunged ~89% over 9 days. Renewal in 16 days. Their product lead left and procurement asked for a short competitor trial. Need triage + retention play.

telemetry-bot: Alert: customer=HalcyonHealth, metric=tokens_9d, change=-89%, seats=12->4, errors=1.1%->4.9%, recent_deploy=2026-03-09. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/customers/halcyonhealth/health

kevin_sales: I spoke to procurement earlier. They mentioned "time outs" and that VectorAI proposed a 1-week low-cost pilot. Price is a factor but reliability is the reason they're considering switching. I'll own the commercial outreach.

ben_eng: Quick check I can run: per-key call volume, error_code histogram, and instance-level memory spikes around 3/14-3/18. If anyone can grab a failing request id that speeds things up.

eva_ops: On billing side, noticed seat count dropped in the middle of the month in our billing logs. Could be accidental seat revocation or org change. I'll verify.

telemetry-bot: Query summary: top_errors=502(57%), 429(22%), 401(21%). Top key last active 2026-03-14. Spike of 502s correlates with a client payload size increase.

sara_csm: Scheduling short call with their PM in 20m. I'll ask for three failing request ids and whether they rotated keys or toggled a preview endpoint.

kevin_sales: I'll prepare a one-pager: 14-day dedicated trial (non-contract, limited throughput), 1-hr tech pairing, and performance numbers vs VectorAI. Need finance OK for credits > $4k. Tagging @finance in the call notes.

ben_eng: If 502s match payload spikes, mitigation options: (1) advise client to throttle large batches, (2) enable temporary higher memory headroom for their account, (3) block preview endpoint routing. I can implement (2) if ops confirm.

eva_ops: Confirmed billing change: two admin seats were removed on 2026-03-15 by an automated deprovision job tied to SSO. We should flag possible accidental revocations during onboarding.

sara_csm: On the call now — PM sent two ids: req_20260315_x9 and req_20260317_z4. They confirm their infra rotated a key on 3/14 and they were testing a beta endpoint.

ben_eng: Triage: req_20260315_x9 -> 502 due to large payload (16k tokens) and router OOM; req_20260317_z4 -> 401 old key. Root cause = simultaneous payload spike + partial key rotation + beta endpoint route.

kevin_sales: Commercial quick-win: offer 10-day dedicated window at 3x baseline throughput while they finish rollout testing. Will propose in writing and ask for acceptance today.

eva_ops: Ops can temporarily increase account memory headroom and whitelist their IP for test period. Also reversing accidental seat removal will restore admin access.

ben_eng: I'll push config change to limit concurrent huge payloads and enable a temporary higher memory pool for their account. Will monitor for 2-3 hours.

sara_csm: Sending offer email now: 10-day dedicated window, 3x throughput, 1-hour pairing session, and a post-trial performance report. Asking for the new API key and a couple more failing ids.

telemetry-bot: Interim snapshot 4h later: tokens/day recovered to 72% baseline after key reconciliation + memory bump; 502s down to 1.4%; 401s resolved.

kevin_sales: Finance approved unilateral credit and confirmed we can proceed without an amendment for this goodwill window. I emailed confirmation and dates. Procurement paused VectorAI pilot pending our trial.

eva_ops: Updated account playbook with renewal-risk tag, owners, and due dates. Added note to fix auto-deprovision rule for SSO to avoid seat accidents.

sara_csm: Follow-up plan: 48h monitor, 7-day check-in, schedule QBR before renewal. Will update thread with QBR date.

(later) telemetry-bot: Final snapshot 24h later: tokens/day at 97% baseline, error rate 0.5%. Thread will be closed when QBR scheduled.
